figs.name: rtd-resistance-formula-pt100-infographic
figs.alt: RTD resistance formula with Pt100 at 200 °C worked example and resistance graph
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the RTD formula R equals R0 times 1 plus alpha T, with a Pt100 reading 177.0 ohm and a Pt1000 reading 1770.0 ohm at 200 °C.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>RTD resistance formula infographic with Pt100 and Pt1000 worked example and graph</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">RTD Resistance Formula</text>
<rect x="30" y="60" width="350" height="470" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="205" y="105" font-size="22" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">R(T) = R₀ × (1 + α × T)</text>
<text x="55" y="150" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">R₀ = 100 Ω for Pt100</text>
<text x="55" y="180" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">R₀ = 1000 Ω for Pt1000</text>
<text x="55" y="210" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">α = 0.00385 Ω/Ω/°C</text>
<text x="55" y="240" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">T in °C, 0 to 400 °C</text>
<text x="205" y="300" font-size="19" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Worked example at 200 °C</text>
<text x="55" y="340" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Pt100: 100 × (1 + 0.00385 × 200)</text>
<text x="55" y="372" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">= 100 × 1.77 = 177.0 Ω</text>
<text x="55" y="404" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Pt1000: 1000 × 1.77</text>
<text x="55" y="436" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">= 1770.0 Ω</text>
<text x="205" y="500" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Real table at 200 °C: 175.86 Ω</text>
<line x1="460" y1="480" x2="760" y2="480" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="460" y1="480" x2="460" y2="90" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="460.0" y="506" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
<text x="600.0" y="506" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">100</text>
<text x="740.0" y="506" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">200</text>
<text x="450" y="418.72727272727275" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">100</text>
<line x1="460" y1="412.72727272727275" x2="760" y2="412.72727272727275" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="450" y="284.1818181818182" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">140</text>
<line x1="460" y1="278.1818181818182" x2="760" y2="278.1818181818182" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<text x="450" y="149.63636363636363" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">180</text>
<line x1="460" y1="143.63636363636363" x2="760" y2="143.63636363636363" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1"/>
<line x1="460.0" y1="412.72727272727275" x2="740.0" y2="153.72727272727275" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="4"/>
<circle cx="460" cy="413" r="6" fill="#5b21b6"/>
<text x="472.0" y="400.72727272727275" font-size="17" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">100 Ω</text>
<circle cx="600" cy="283" r="6" fill="#5b21b6"/>
<text x="612.0" y="271.22727272727275" font-size="17" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">138.5 Ω</text>
<circle cx="740" cy="154" r="6" fill="#5b21b6"/>
<text x="728.0" y="141.72727272727275" font-size="17" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">177.0 Ω</text>
<text x="610" y="532" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Temperature in °C</text>
<text x="610" y="75" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pt100 resistance in Ω</text>
</svg>

figs.name: rtd-field-check-resistance-table-flowchart
figs.alt: how to check a Pt100 RTD with a multimeter and resistance table flowchart
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the field check for a platinum RTD: disconnect, measure, subtract lead resistance, compare with the Pt100 table and judge the element.
figs.after_h2: Platinum RTD Resistance Table for Pt100 and Pt1000
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>RTD field check flowchart using the Pt100 resistance table</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Checking an RTD With the Resistance Table</text>
<rect x="30" y="70" width="350" height="80" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="104.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Disconnect the RTD</text>
<text x="205.0" y="128.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">from the transmitter</text>
<rect x="420" y="70" width="350" height="80" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="595.0" y="104.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Measure resistance</text>
<text x="595.0" y="128.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">across the leads</text>
<rect x="30" y="175" width="350" height="80" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="209.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. For 3 wire, subtract</text>
<text x="205.0" y="233.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the lead resistance</text>
<rect x="420" y="175" width="350" height="80" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="595.0" y="209.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Measure bath temp</text>
<text x="595.0" y="233.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">with a reference</text>
<line x1="382" y1="110" x2="418" y2="110" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="605,152 605,162 205,162 205,172" fill="none" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="382" y1="215" x2="418" y2="215" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="605,257 605,272 400,272 400,285" fill="none" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,290.0 610.0,345 400,400.0 190.0,345" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="351.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Matches table value?</text>
<polyline points="190,345 130,345 130,420" fill="none" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="165" y="333" font-size="17" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<polyline points="610,345 670,345 670,420" fill="none" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="640" y="333" font-size="17" fill="#b91c1c" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="25" y="425" width="250" height="90" rx="10" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="150.0" y="452.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sensor is healthy</text>
<text x="150.0" y="475.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">reconnect and</text>
<text x="150.0" y="498.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">return to service</text>
<rect x="505" y="425" width="270" height="90" rx="10" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="640.0" y="452.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Large deviation, open</text>
<text x="640.0" y="475.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">circuit or near zero Ω</text>
<text x="640.0" y="498.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">means damaged element</text>
<text x="400" y="555" font-size="17" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pt100 table: 100.00 Ω at 0 °C, 138.51 Ω at 100 °C, 175.86 Ω at 200 °C</text>
<text x="400" y="584" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Pt1000 values are ten times larger</text>
</svg>
